title: Insecure Direct Object Reference Security Analysis

vulnerability.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference
vulnerability.description: Vulnerabilities exposing direct references to internal objects
vulnerability.impact: Unauthorized access to data, privilege escalation, or data theft
vulnerability.mitigation: Implement proper access controls, use indirect references, validate user authorization

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: The contract exposes direct reference to an internal object (user's credit) without proper access control checks.
findings.impact: Unauthorized access to data or privilege escalation
exploitation_steps: Call the withdraw function with an arbitrary amount
Manipulate the credit variable directly as msg.sender is used
findings.exploitation_conditions: Attacker has the ability to call the withdraw function.
findings.remediation: Implement proper access controls, use indirect references or check-effects-interactions pattern for credit[msg.sender]

chunk_analyses.notes: In this case, the vulnerability is remediated by adding checks-effects-interactions pattern in SimpleDAO contract.

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: The contract function airDrop uses the msg.sender address directly as the object reference, bypassing proper authorization checks.
findings.impact: An attacker can manipulate the balance of any contract that supports the Nu Token by calling airDrop while having a zero balance.
exploitation_steps: Call airDrop while having a zero balance
Manipulate the msg.sender parameter to any contract address
findings.remediation: Implement proper access controls or use indirect object references.
